name: cronograma-lancamentos
description: Cronograma de lançamentos Cortag — web conectado ao ClickUp

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev:demo -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
